actual_hs_list: 8708.70 — road wheels, their parts and accessories (steel wheels for cars/UVs, trucks, LCVs, buses, tractors; forged and cast aluminium wheels; earthmover/OTR wheels 35" and 49")
8716.90 — parts of trailers and other non-mechanically-propelled vehicles (trailer/trailer-axle wheels, aftermarket 'TVS WILGO' wheel line for truck and trailer manufacturers)
8708.80 — suspension systems and parts thereof (air suspension kits for trucks and buses) — NOT in declaration
8708.99 — other parts and accessories of motor vehicles (possible residual for wheel components/assemblies, unconfirmed)
product_summary: Real product lines per the company's own official LinkedIn company page (linkedin.com/company/wheels-india-limited, 'About us' + Specialties): steel wheels for cars, UVs, commercial vehicles, tractors, construction & earth-mover equipment; forged aluminium wheels (since 2005) and cast aluminium wheels; bus wheels; tractor wheels; earthmover/OTR wheels in 35" and 49" sizes (entered 2000); aftermarket wheel brand 'TVS WILGO' (launched 2012); and air suspension kits for trucks and buses. OEM supplier to Ford, Hyundai, Tata, Caterpillar, John Deere, Komatsu, Hyundai Heavy Industries, Case New Holland, Leyland, TAFE, Suzuki. Established 1962, TVS Group, Chennai (Padi) + Sriperumbudur, Bawal, Pantnagar plants. NOTE: wheelsindia.com returned HTTP 403 on every attempt and the search backend was unavailable (connection refused), so the product catalogue could not be opened directly; the product list above rests on the company's own LinkedIn profile, not on the website catalogue.
comment: HS mapping: declared 870870 (road wheels and parts) is EXACT and is the core of the business — steel, forged aluminium, cast aluminium, tractor, bus, car and earthmover wheels all fall in 8708.70. Declared 871690 (parts of trailers/non-mechanically-propelled vehicles) is PARTIAL/plausible: it fits the trailer and trailer-axle wheel business and the 'TVS WILGO' aftermarket line aimed at truck and trailer manufacturers, but the company's own description frames these as wheels for trucks/trailers rather than as trailer parts, so 8716.90 is a secondary, not primary, heading. MISSING FROM DECLARATION: air suspension kits for trucks and buses — these are suspension systems, HS 8708.80, not wheels, and are a distinct declared product segment on the company's own page; the declaration does not cover them. Also possibly 8708.99 for wheel components/assemblies, unconfirmed. Industry classification 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aircraft & transport) is imprecise: this is purely automotive/off-highway component manufacturing (auto components, TVS Group) with no aerospace activity found — the 'авиастроение' part is a misclassification, 'транспорт' is correct. No trader signs: own plants in Padi/Sriperumbudur/Bawal/Pantnagar, OEM approvals and supplier-quality awards (CAT SQEP, Toyota supplier awards) indicate a genuine manufacturer, not a trader. Per project rule 3, the partial HS coverage is NOT grounds for rejection — company is retained and the code set should be corrected/extended to 870870 + 871690 + 870880. All product claims here are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' in the customs sense: no customs line or B/L record was examined in this task (out of scope), so no shipment-level corroboration is asserted. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and registry data were not researched per task scope — null.
